checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: 6-second landscape 16:9 video of a mountain lake at dusk
must.why: Wide 854x480 frames of an alpine lake with pale, low-saturation light and faint alpenglow. The agent called it morning light, but it passes as dusk.

must.item: Gentle ripples visibly animate the water
must.why: Ripple patterns in the reflection change from frame to frame, so the water is animating.

must.item: Camera remains fixed, no pans, zooms or cuts
must.why: The shoreline trees and banks shift between frames, and the agent said there is a slow camera glide. This is a forward drift, not a locked-off shot. The mountains barely move and there are no cuts.

must.item: Repeated playback has no perceptible jump at the boundary
must.why: Frames 1 and 4 differ in ripple state and tree and bank position. The clip is not designed to loop, so a visible reset on repeat is likely.

must.item: Centre remains visually calm, no prominent moving foreground objects
must.why: The centre is a calm reflection with no foreground objects.

must.item: No visible text and no audible sound
must.why: No text appears in any frame, and the clip was requested silent.

faults.what: The camera drifts forward even though a fixed camera was needed for a banner background.
The clip is not seamlessly loopable, so there is probably a jump when it repeats on the website.
The output is soft at 854x480 for a banner.

summary: The clip is a good-looking, calm, wide mountain lake with gently rippling water and no text. It has a slow forward camera drift, and it is not built to loop, so repeats will likely show a jump.
